notes: Summary: GlimmerPath builds a B2B support automation layer focused on ticket deflection + agent assist. Evaluating Redwood for embeddings + reranking pipeline to meet tight latency SLOs and cost targets.
Scale: ~12–18M indexed documents (tickets + KB + release notes). Expect steady-state growth ~1M docs / quarter.
Workload: real-time support queries (chat widget + search bar) + nightly offline indexing. Typical bursts from marketing campaigns—need graceful burst handling.
Latency targets: 95th pct end-to-end (retrieve + rerank + response assembly) <= 300ms; P50 target <= 70ms. Cannot accept 95th > 350ms for customer-facing widget.
Throughput: average 40 qps, target sustained 200 qps for peak windows; cost-sensitive to token and CPU/GPU spend per query.

Retrieval design preference: hybrid vector + sparse (bm25) to reduce recall gaps. Embedding dimension preference 768–1024. Interested in Redwood suggestions for quantized embeddings to save storage/cost.

Reranking: must run a cross-encoder reranker on top-10 then present top-5. Acceptance criteria: top-5 precision (manual eval) >= 92% on ticket samples; prefer model variants that can rerank within ~50–120ms depending on hardware.

POC ask: benchmark pipeline for 10M and 15M index sizes with 3 routing scenarios (hosted, dedicated, vpc private). Measure: p50/p95 latency, cost/query, and deflection delta vs baseline (current Elastic+BM25).
Security/compliance: SSO via SAML, audit logs retention 1 year, KMS integration for encryption keys, EU data residency for EU customers. Need SOC2 + ISO27001 assurance for procurement.
Customer quotes: 'We need a reranker that actually moves the needle on top-5 accuracy — our current pipeline returns noisy top-1s.' — Head of CX (call 2026-02-12).

- Show ability to fall back to smaller model variant under heavy load with <3x degradation in accuracy for critical flows.
